# M8-00 reference timelines. See the M8-00 section of re/harness/README.md.
# Setup frame 0 becomes trace frame 0; lag can change video frame timing.

# BT-A6; recipe d3d/r1.txt / s7-1p-a
segment m800_bta6_s7_1p_a
jump 7 3 0x240 char=jack
god on
rank 12
0 snapshot keep
0-900:R
200 killall
320 killall
440 killall
trace 2600
